name: flutter-bist-editor
description: BIST script library (bist.ts) and editor source. `npm run build` writes ../../bin/{editor.html,bist.mjs,bist.d.ts}.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node build.mjs
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node build.mjs --check
